text: {"headline":"Referral Export Bucket Exposure: Timeline and Conflicting Records Review","overview":"This brief summarizes documented records concerning a referral export found in a storage bucket in March 2026, subsequent access controls, incident reclassification, and a closure memo that conflicts with earlier accessibility evidence. It distinguishes documented test results and logs from unattributed statements and notes gaps in independent verification.","key_points":["Oriel Fen discovered a referral export in a public storage bucket on 4 March 2026 [C001]","The export manifest counts 2,184 rows, with referral reason and appointment date fields [C002]","An unauthenticated HEAD request returned 200 in the attached test log, which establishes accessibility at that instant, not that any outsider downloaded the file [C003, C004]","Access logging was enabled only after the bucket was closed, so the missing download log cannot settle whether a download occurred [C005]","The following Monday, Oriel Fen disabled anonymous access to the export bucket [C006]","Two days later, PERSON_1 PERSON_1 changed incident ORG_2 418 from privacy exposure to routine maintenance [C007]","In early April, PERSON_1 deferred the notification decision pending legal review [C008]","After the audit, Oriel Fen preserved the bucket access policy in the incident vault [C009]","PERSON_1 PERSON_1's closure memo says the referral export was never publicly accessible, which contradicts the earlier discovery in a public bucket and the HEAD 200 accessibility finding [C010, C001, C004]","No signed audit report was available for the packet [C011]"],"risk_notes":["Contradiction between documented accessibility evidence and closure memo assertion creates uncertainty about public exposure status","Absence of access logging during the exposure window prevents independent confirmation of download activity","Incident reclassification and deferred notification decision documented without accompanying rationale in the supplied evidence"],"limitations":["Evidence does not show whether any outsider downloaded the file; HEAD 200 establishes accessibility at an instant only","Evidence does not include a signed audit report or independent proof corroborating the closure memo's assertion","Reporter allegations that the incident label changed during collection and that the reporter was told to leave out the word exposure lack independent document verification in the supplied passages","Evidence does not establish intent, fault, or legal compliance, and does not identify individuals behind placeholder names"]}
